  "title": "History visibility = joined fails on kicks",
  "body": "I've had reports that when the IRC bridge kicks a user and the user subsequently rejoins the room, they have zero history whatsoever. They should have had history up until the point they were kicked. Details in linked issues.",
  "author": "Participant 1",

      "body": "<https://matrix.to/#/!tcQYxOpEjoqDUWuieS:matrix.org/$1494076409781795CaVGg:matrix.org> (2017-05-06): \r\n\r\n> Successfully stored password on chat.freenode.net. When you next reconnect to chat.freenode.net, this password will be automatically sent in a PASS command which most IRC networks will use as your NickServ password. This means you will not need to talk to NickServ. This does NOT apply to your currently active connection: you still need to talk to NickServ one last time to authenticate your current connection if you haven't already.\r\n\r\nFriday 2018-07-20: \r\n\r\n> @appservice-irc:matrix.org\r\n> 01:46\r\n> Could not join ##bsd on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> 01:50\r\n> Could not join #freebsd on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> 01:51\r\n> Could not join ##mac on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> @appservice-irc:matrix.org\r\n> 02:24\r\n> Could not join #zfs on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> @appservice-irc:matrix.org\r\n> 02:51\r\n> Could not join #firefox on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> @appservice-irc:matrix.org\r\n> 10:50\r\n> Could not join ##mac on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> 10:50\r\n> Could not join #freebsd on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> 10:54\r\n> Could not join ##bsd on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> @appservice-irc:matrix.org\r\n> 11:21\r\n> Could not join #zfs on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> @appservice-irc:matrix.org\r\n> 11:41\r\n> Could not join #firefox on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> @appservice-irc:matrix.org\r\n> 23:05\r\n> Could not join ##mac on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> 23:06\r\n> Could not join #freebsd on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n> 23:10\r\n> Could not join ##bsd on 'chat.freenode.net': err_needreggednick\r\n\r\nhttps://matrix.to/#/!QtykxKocfZaZOUrTwp:matrix.org/$1534030729558617PYIIK:matrix.org (2018-08-18): \r\n\r\n> … I'm back in #freenode_#freebsd:matrix.org but there's no history: …\r\n\r\nAFAICT, there are <strike>two </strike>at least three rooms where I can't regain the history: \r\n\r\n- #firefox\r\n- #freebsd\r\n- #zfs"
    },
    {
      "id": 546563752,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-546563752",

      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "I deleted a few of my previous comments. \r\n\r\nApologies for the noise (and the misplaced frustration) … it took me months to ~~realise~~ remember the need for a `!storepass` command. (I had used the command around two years ago, May 2017.) https://matrix.to/#/!QtykxKocfZaZOUrTwp:matrix.org/$157205677388571IgvGv:matrix.org"
    },
    {
      "id": 808797422,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-808797422",
      "created_at": "2021-03-27T20:23:28Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "It was confusing for the room to just be gone as if one hadn't ever joined. However after rejoining, first the history is still gone. Then search for something in the room, even if it will give no results. Afterwards the history will be visible."
    },
    {
      "id": 808834529,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-808834529",
      "created_at": "2021-03-28T02:38:20Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "> … Afterwards the history will be visible.\r\n\r\nIf I recall correctly, this is true only if the room specifically makes history visible to newcomers. "
    },
    {
      "id": 808942357,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-808942357",
      "created_at": "2021-03-28T18:59:04Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "This was a room from the matrix.org irc bridge with visibility = joined. I can now see the history from when I was in the room, not any from when I wasn't in the room."
    },
    {
      "id": 826382228,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-826382228",
      "created_at": "2021-04-25T20:06:59Z",
      "updated_at": "2021-04-26T06:35:21Z",
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Did anything occur in the last 24 hours or so that might explain a kick and yet another loss of all history? \r\n\r\n![2021-04-25 20:56:01](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/192271/116007924-02b17480-a60a-11eb-9ad9-65cbe859b52c.png)\r\n\r\n![2021-04-25 20:59:34](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/192271/116007942-1e1c7f80-a60a-11eb-8a1c-ca2068524783.png)\r\n\r\n### Postscript\r\n\r\n![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/192271/116038431-5602e180-a661-11eb-9371-cb2cf8b1066b.png)\r\n\r\n(I made the discovery through discussion in Discord. It seems that global notices from IRC are not represented in Element.)\r\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 829129114,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-829129114",
      "created_at": "2021-04-29T10:48:32Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "@grahamperrin I'm afraid I don't understand what those screenshots are meant to show me. Are you saying that the IRC bridge is kicking you from a particular room? That would be a matter for the IRC bridge, not Synapse."
    },
    {
      "id": 829131557,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-829131557",
      "created_at": "2021-04-29T10:52:23Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "In terms of whether history is visible after you are kicked from and then rejoin a room - I would expect that to work ok, but it's certainly possible there is a bug there. I can't see it would be specific to IRC-bridged rooms, though.\r\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 829247661,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-829247661",
      "created_at": "2021-04-29T13:40:55Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "@richvdh what more information do you need for this issue?\r\n\r\nYes this is not an issue specific to irc-bridged rooms, I asked in the irc-bridge chat and someone confirmed the same problem in an room unrelated to the bridge."
    },
    {
      "id": 829732291,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-829732291",
      "created_at": "2021-04-30T01:20:57Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-829129114\r\n\r\n> … what those screenshots are meant to show …\r\n\r\nSorry. In retrospect, I see that there's insufficient detail at the foot of the second shot. \r\n\r\nRe: https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-appservice-irc/wiki/End-user-FAQ#i-am-getting-kicked-out-of-a-bridged-room-with-the--err_needreggednick-error I got: \r\n\r\n`err_needreggednick`\r\n\r\n– and re: the third shot, I assume that this was a consequence of a server being offline at some point. \r\n\r\nThrough no fault of mine: all history disappeared, and did not reappear after I reidentified. "
    },
    {
      "id": 829997193,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-829997193",
      "created_at": "2021-04-30T10:21:27Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "> Through no fault of mine: all history disappeared, and did not reappear after I reidentified \r\n\r\nto be clear: history visibility in Matrix is unrelated to IRC nick registration (though identifying with the nickserv *is* necessary to stop you being kicked from IRC channels which require that, of course).\r\n\r\n> Yes this is not an issue specific to irc-bridged rooms, I asked in the irc-bridge chat and someone confirmed the same problem in an room unrelated to the bridge.\r\n\r\nI have been unable to reproduce this in testing. I have tried leaving a room and rejoining, and being kicked from a room and rejoining. In both cases my client was able to retrieve history from the room.\r\n\r\nI've gone digging in the `matrix.org` logs and database to see if I can see what happened to @grahamperrin on 25th April. I see the kicks and rejoins:\r\n\r\n```\r\n      to_timestamp      |              event_id              |           sender           |        state_key         |                                                   content                                                    \r\n------------------------+------------------------------------+----------------------------+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n 2021-04-25 20:58:41+01 | $16193807215874406imsbM:matrix.org | @grahamperrin:matrix.org   | @grahamperrin:matrix.org | {\"avatar_url\":\"mxc://matrix.org/cooObxhGLEeJhcIlyPPaUDiw\",\"displayname\":\"Graham Perrin\",\"membership\":\"join\"}\r\n 2021-04-25 20:46:25+01 | $16193799851356577HdifR:matrix.org | @appservice-irc:matrix.org | @grahamperrin:matrix.org | {\"membership\":\"leave\",\"reason\":\"IRC error on #freebsd: err_needreggednick\"}\r\n 2021-04-25 20:46:24+01 | $16193799845863170Waxlt:matrix.org | @grahamperrin:matrix.org   | @grahamperrin:matrix.org | {\"avatar_url\":\"mxc://matrix.org/cooObxhGLEeJhcIlyPPaUDiw\",\"displayname\":\"Graham Perrin\",\"membership\":\"join\"}\r\n 2021-04-24 23:01:35+01 | $16193016951076927xLyxk:matrix.org | @appservice-irc:matrix.org | @grahamperrin:matrix.org | {\"membership\":\"leave\",\"reason\":\"IRC error on #freebsd: err_needreggednick\"}\r\n```\r\n\r\n... but I *don't* see any attempt by a client to retrieve history for that room around that time.\r\n\r\nThis leads me to suspect a client-side bug. "
    },
    {
      "id": 830018880,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-830018880",
      "created_at": "2021-04-30T11:05:22Z",
      "updated_at": "2021-04-30T11:05:53Z",
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "It doesn't always happen after a kick. When it happened to me I had the problem on both Element Android and Mirage. On the next few times I didn't have the problem.\r\n\r\nNote that the channel also didn't show in the roster when the problem happened until I rejoined it, then after I rejoined it would not show history from before until I did a search."
    },
    {
      "id": 830038371,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-830038371",
      "created_at": "2021-04-30T11:46:29Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "Of course, it helps if you grep for the right thing. Here are the history requests @grahamperrin's client sent after he rejoined:\r\n\r\n```\r\n2021-04-25 19:58:43,304 - synapse.access.http.8146 - 393 - INFO - GET-3532826 - 88.105.96.80 - 8146 - {@grahamperrin:matrix.org} Processed request: 0.141sec/-0.000sec (0.050sec, 0.001sec) (0.005sec/0.087sec/9) 218B 200 \"GET /_matrix/client/r0/rooms/!qZXgYtEIHagWHrEQQb%3Amatrix.org/messages?from=t1259814-1971203433_757284961_13387972_840135145_729647167_2261531_252083715_957747346_191565&limit=20&dir=b&filter=%7B%22lazy_load_members%22%3Atrue%7D HTTP/1.1\" \"Mozilla/5.0 (X11; FreeBSD amd64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0\" [21 dbevts]\r\n2021-04-25 19:58:43,502 - synapse.access.http.8148 - 393 - INFO - GET-3534413 - 88.105.96.80 - 8148 - {@grahamperrin:matrix.org} Processed request: 0.111sec/-0.000sec (0.037sec, 0.010sec) (0.002sec/0.082sec/8) 218B 200 \"GET /_matrix/client/r0/rooms/!qZXgYtEIHagWHrEQQb%3Amatrix.org/messages?from=t1259794-1971188387_757284961_13387972_840135145_729647167_2261531_252083715_957747346_191565&limit=20&dir=b&filter=%7B%22lazy_load_members%22%3Atrue%7D HTTP/1.1\" \"Mozilla/5.0 (X11; FreeBSD amd64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0\" [1 dbevts]\r\n2021-04-25 19:58:43,902 - synapse.access.http.8149 - 393 - INFO - GET-3534808 - 88.105.96.80 - 8149 - {@grahamperrin:matrix.org} Processed request: 0.143sec/-0.000sec (0.055sec, 0.008sec) (0.004sec/0.083sec/10) 218B 200 \"GET /_matrix/client/r0/rooms/!qZXgYtEIHagWHrEQQb%3Amatrix.org/messages?from=t1259774-1971181568_757284961_13387972_840135145_729647167_2261531_252083715_957747346_191565&limit=20&dir=b&filter=%7B%22lazy_load_members%22%3Atrue%7D HTTP/1.1\" \"Mozilla/5.0 (X11; FreeBSD amd64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0\" [21 dbevts]\r\n2021-04-25 19:58:44,163 - synapse.access.http.8111 - 393 - INFO - GET-3520103 - 88.105.96.80 - 8111 - {@grahamperrin:matrix.org} Processed request: 0.169sec/-0.000sec (0.056sec, 0.011sec) (0.010sec/0.101sec/10) 218B 200 \"GET /_matrix/client/r0/rooms/!qZXgYtEIHagWHrEQQb%3Amatrix.org/messages?from=t1259754-1971173976_757284961_13387972_840135145_729647167_2261531_252083715_957747346_191565&limit=20&dir=b&filter=%7B%22lazy_load_members%22%3Atrue%7D HTTP/1.1\" \"Mozilla/5.0 (X11; FreeBSD amd64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0\" [21 dbevts]\r\n2021-04-25 19:58:46,584 - synapse.access.http.8090 - 393 - INFO - GET-3524648 - 88.105.96.80 - 8090 - {@grahamperrin:matrix.org} Processed request: 2.345sec/-0.000sec (0.052sec, 0.004sec) (0.032sec/0.188sec/8) 218B 200 \"GET /_matrix/client/r0/rooms/!qZXgYtEIHagWHrEQQb%3Amatrix.org/messages?from=t1259734-1971170676_757284961_13387972_840135145_729647167_2261531_252083715_957747346_191565&limit=20&dir=b&filter=%7B%22lazy_load_members%22%3Atrue%7D HTTP/1.1\" \"Mozilla/5.0 (X11; FreeBSD amd64; rv:88.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/88.0\" [21 dbevts]\r\n```\r\n\r\nThere are several backfill requests there, all of which look to be returning empty results.\r\n\r\nIt looks like what's going on here is that Synapse is working its way through the 1053 events in the room between @grahamperrin's kick on 24th April and his rejoin on 25th April that he is not allowed to see (so returning an empty resultset). What is not clear to me is why element decides to stop paginating - it should continue to send requests until it hits visible events, or you switch to a different room.\r\n\r\nThe best thing I can suggest right now is to report a bug in the client. For element-web, attaching the debug logs next time it happens will likely help the developers."
    },
    {
      "id": 830062788,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-830062788",
      "created_at": "2021-04-30T12:34:09Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "That still doesn't explain why sometimes the room is not in the client roster. I suspect that in one case of this bug for some reason such a room is not included in the response for the clients initial sync. Not seeing the room in the roster happened to me on https://matrix.to/#/#irc:matrix.org which has history_visibility:shared, so that didn't result in a history problem. But I suspect on rooms that have it set to joined the reason that the client has not seen it in sync results in the client not requesting enough history."
    },
    {
      "id": 830093760,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-830093760",
      "created_at": "2021-04-30T13:26:42Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "@JanZerebecki by \"client roster\" you mean the room list in the client?\r\n\r\nIf the room is visible in the client at all (even with no history) then that suggests the room is in the /sync response. If it's not there... maybe you're not in the room? Either way, it sounds like a separate problem to me and I encourage you to file a separate bug clearly detailing what happened. (From your description: you were kicked, you rejoined (how?), the room was missing from the room list?, you rejoined *again*? (how?))"
    },
    {
      "id": 830170407,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-830170407",
      "created_at": "2021-04-30T15:21:08Z",
      "updated_at": "2021-04-30T15:26:24Z",
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "OW. I missed that sync doesn't include historical rooms unless you add a include_leave filter. Yes, I meant the room list. I can't find element android making use of include_leave, even though the android sdk has functionality for it, seems https://github.com/vector-im/element-android/issues/49 is the issue for that missing feature. Element web has the ui, but it doesn't load anything https://github.com/vector-im/element-web/issues/7850 . Mirage doesn't support it either.\r\n\r\nThx. I can now see how this might be a client bug."
    },
    {
      "id": 833451186,
      "url": "https://github.com/matrix-org/synapse/issues/2212#issuecomment-833451186",
      "created_at": "2021-05-06T11:31:44Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 5",
      "body": "We agree that this is most likely a client bug, thank you for reporting it :)"
    }
